title: Awesome.
text: Awesome.. Wasn’t sure about these. I have a air fryer and needed something other then tinfoil. They are Great!!! I use them for my frozen TV dinners. Just pop it out of the container and place in one of these, cooks great with no leakage.

product_metadata.title: HANAMO Air Fryer Papers 200 PCS Air Fryer Disposable Paper Liner Round Air Fryer Parchment Paper Non-stick Airfryer Parchment Liners for Baking 6.3 Inches
features: 【* Note *】: Please do not put the air fryer parchment paper in fryer without food during preheat or the fan will suck them up and fire can easily occur.

【Food Grade Material】: The air fryer disposable paper liner is made of food grade parchment paper, which is waterproof, oil proof and non-stick! High temperature resistance up to 428 degrees Fahrenheit, 100% safe.

【Keep your Air Fryer Clean】: The air fryer parchment paper can prevent food residue from falling into the basket, and the edge is raised to 1.75 inches, which can prevent oil stains from splashing on the side of the fryer, keep it as clean as before.

【Easy to Use】: The air fryer paper liners adopt a round shape design to fit the air fryer perfectly. It means that you do not need to cut or fold the air fryer liners disposable, just put it in the air fryer and use it.

【Wide Applications】: The air fryer disposable paper is also suitable for microwave, ovens, steamers, cookers, etc. It can also be used to hold food, it is a good choice for parties, camping, barbecues.
